_note: Board mm, origin bottom-left, y up, rotation deg (EasyEDA footprint origins: U1 = its pad 1, others = centre). U1 = ESP32-C3 SuperMini OLED, pad 1 (5V) at the USB end, top. Sensor header and ear-hole spacing are ESTIMATES until measured.
_layout: ESP (U1) centred, USB at the top edge. Left of U1 (its left-row pins): opener terminal J2 top, opto block, buzzer driver Q1/R3, LED header J3/R5. Right (right-row pins): buttons, buzzer BZ1 + flyback D2, C1/C2. Sensor U3 across the bottom, rotated so its I2C pins face the right row. Antenna keepout between U1's far end and the sensor.

sensor._part: VL53L8CX red breakout 33 x 10 mm, 1x9 header 2.54 mm, two ear holes for M2 nylon screws
sensor._header: U3 header row along the module long edge 1.5 mm in (y 8.5), module centre (44.5, 12)
